findings.title: The "authority the candidate touched" guard compares commits but reads the authority from the worktree, so an uncommitted edit to the pin check or the flaky register reopens the amnesty
`tests/test_drive.sh:5786` interpolates `$SHIPPED_SIGS` into its own failure message, so a genuine failure of the register-parsing guard is itself classified `flaky` and charges no attempt

`lib/drive.sh`'s env-cascade comment cites `ENOENT ... open '.../node_modules/x'` as a naming match, but `_DRIVE_PATH_TAIL` excludes `/`, so a line that only contains the directory as a path prefix is never claimed
